description: CANONICAL bio record for masters and scholars alike. One shape, two roles (kind). Dates are honesty-flagged: exact | approximate | traditional | unknown. Nothing here asserts what the sources don't support.

affiliation.description: scholars: institution/school; masters: pitha/lineage seat if known

bio.description: paragraph: who, what they did, why they matter here, what is NOT known

note.description: REQUIRED: basis + uncertainty (e.g. Saptarsi calc, Rajatarangini association, traditional)

holdings.description: where their texts/papers live that we hold: volume paths, R2 prefixes, in-repo paths

id.description: lowercase slug, immutable, e.g. abhinavagupta, ratie

image.description: hero image. RULE: no invented likenesses of historical persons — use manuscript folios, lineage diagrams, or context art with an honest caption saying exactly that

caption.description: must state what is shown and that it is not a portrait where no portrait exists

status.description: living | active | historical | lineage | traditional | disputed — active=publishing now; historical=deceased with record; lineage=known through transmission; traditional=dates by tradition

summary.description: one line: who + why they matter to this site

title: ipvv person (canonical bio, masters and scholars alike)
